name: week
description: The Monday the week begins on, in UTC.

name: dimension
description: What the children are told apart by: all, host, language, grade, country, region, signin_country or cohort.

name: value
description: The value of the dimension, as the lines write it; all for the dimension all.

name: learners
description: The children a task was handed to that week, each under the value of its latest task. The values of a dimension add up to all. A week that spans the turn of a month counts a child twice.
